svg.title: Paired utility contrasts against the locked primary

cc:Work.dc:title: Paired utility contrasts against the locked primary
cc:Work.dc:description: Intervals are the stored paired contrast estimates; they are not obtained by subtracting marginal confidence limits. The open square is the exact zero reference. Pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 crossed seed × scenario resamples. All 16 configurations are shown in a fixed order. Expected-utility contrasts average four latent paths; realized query draws do not enter these intervals. Five seeds limit precision; there is no family-wise significance claim.
